title: Concept: Koa error with its internal stack
description: A Koa error response that carries the ctx stack in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The stack lists the middleware chain and the file that threw, which tells an attacker which middleware sits in front of the handler and where to aim.
applicability: Deployments that render a Koa error response that carries the ctx stack into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The stack lists the middleware chain and the file that threw, which tells an attacker which middleware sits in front of the handler and where to aim.
